conditionOrder.registryUse: order of conditions (client variants) within blocks
conditionOrder.usedFor: order of the conditions within every round or block: S1 cell (method x transport) order per round, then S2 cell order per round, then the S4 variant order of every block (pass by pass), then the S5 variant order of every block

readOrder.registryUse: order of the registry reads within rounds
readOrder.usedFor: S3 cell (client x read, and the read sets) order per round

verifierPool.registryUse: verifier presentation pool and its order
verifierPool.usedFor: S4 presentation (pre-generated reply) order per pass

walletReads.usedFor: S5 presentation (wallet request) order per pass
